edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, CNBC reported “The electric vehicle company reported delivery of 19,248 units from July through September”; on the same day, Reuters reported “Rivian Automotive (RIVN.O) reported record third-quarter deliveries on Friday”.

On 2026-10-02, CNBC reported “The electric vehicle company reported delivery of 19,248 units from July through September”; on the same day, Reuters reported “Rivian delivered a record 19,248 vehicles in the quarter ended September 30, beating analysts' average estimate of 18,001 vehicles, according to data compiled by Visible Alpha.”.

On 2026-10-02, Reuters reported “Rivian delivered a record 19,248 vehicles in the quarter ended September 30, beating analysts' average estimate of 18,001 vehicles, according to data compiled by Visible Alpha.”; on the same day, Reuters reported “Rivian Automotive (RIVN.O) reported record third-quarter deliveries on Friday”.

On 2026-10-02, CNBC reported “Rivian Automotive on Friday reconfirmed its 2026 vehicle delivery guidance”; on the same day, Reuters reported “Rivian reaffirmed its 2026 delivery forecast of 65,000 to 70,000 vehicles, saying quarterly production and deliveries were in line with its expectations.”.

On 2026-10-02, CNBC reported “Rivian's 2026 guidance for vehicle deliveries, which it raised earlier this year, is between 65,000 and 70,000 vehicles.”; on the same day, CNBC reported “Rivian Automotive on Friday reconfirmed its 2026 vehicle delivery guidance”.
